name: Panadol Extra 500mg/65mg Tablet
description: Panadol Extra provides tough pain relief and fever reduction. Formulated with a combination of Paracetamol and Caffeine, it offers up to 37% more powerful pain relief than standard paracetamol tablets without irritating the stomach.
uses: Fast relief from tough pain including migraine, severe headache, toothache, period pain, backache, and fever.
benefits: Contains caffeine which enhances the analgesic efficacy of paracetamol for faster and stronger pain relief.
sideEffects: Mild insomnia or restlessness if taken close to bedtime due to caffeine content. Rare allergic skin reactions.
howToUse: Take 1 to 2 tablets every 4 to 6 hours as needed. Do not exceed 8 tablets in 24 hours.
working: Paracetamol works by inhibiting prostaglandin synthesis in the central nervous system, while Caffeine accelerates its absorption and enhances pain relief action.
safetyAdvice: Do not take with other paracetamol-containing products. Avoid excessive intake of caffeine (coffee, tea) while taking this medicine. Unsafe with heavy alcohol consumption.
quickTips: Take with a full glass of water after meals to minimize any mild stomach discomfort.
storage: Store below 30°C in a dry place away from direct heat and sunlight.

name: Brufen 400mg Tablet
description: Brufen 400mg Tablet is a Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drug (NSAID) widely used to relieve mild to moderate pain, reduce inflammation, and lower fever in conditions affecting muscles, joints, and bones.
uses: Relief of mild to moderate pain such as headache, dental pain, dysmenorrhea (period cramps), muscle aches, post-operative pain, and joint pain in rheumatoid arthritis.
benefits: Provides potent anti-inflammatory action along with pain relief, helping restore joint mobility and comfort.
sideEffects: Nausea, heartburn, stomach upset, abdominal pain, dizziness, or mild diarrhea.
howToUse: Take 1 tablet 2 to 3 times daily after food. Do not take on an empty stomach.
working: Ibuprofen inhibits COX-1 and COX-2 enzymes, thereby blocking the synthesis of proinflammatory prostaglandins responsible for pain, fever, and swelling.
safetyAdvice: Use with caution in patients with history of peptic ulcers, asthma, or kidney impairment. Avoid alcohol while taking NSAIDs.
quickTips: Always take Brufen with a glass of milk or immediately after meals to protect your stomach lining.
storage: Store below 25°C in a dry place protected from light.

name: Risek 40mg Capsule
description: Risek 40mg Capsule contains Omeprazole, a selective proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that decreases the amount of acid produced in the stomach. It is highly effective in treating acid reflux, heartburn, and peptic ulcers.
uses: Treatment of Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD), erosive esophagitis, gastric ulcers, duodenal ulcers, and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.
benefits: Provides 24-hour long-lasting suppression of gastric acid, allowing the esophagus and stomach lining time to heal.
sideEffects: Headache, abdominal pain, diarrhea, flatulence, nausea, vomiting, or constipation.
howToUse: Take 1 capsule once daily in the morning, 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast. Swallow whole with water.
working: Omeprazole irreversibly blocks the H+/K+-ATPase enzyme system (proton pump) in gastric parietal cells, shutting down acid production at its final stage.
safetyAdvice: Long-term use (over 1 year) may decrease magnesium absorption and Vitamin B12 levels. Consult doctor if symptoms persist over 14 days.
quickTips: Swallow capsule whole with water. Do not chew, open, or crush the capsule.
storage: Store below 30°C in a dry place away from light and moisture.

name: Augmentin 625mg Tablet
description: Augmentin 625mg is a broad-spectrum antibiotic combination consisting of Amoxicillin (a penicillin antibiotic) and Clavulanate Potassium (a beta-lactamase inhibitor) designed to eradicate penicillin-resistant bacterial infections.
uses: Treatment of bacterial infections of upper & lower respiratory tract, sinus infections, otitis media, urinary tract infections, skin & soft tissue infections, and dental abscesses.
benefits: Clavulanic acid inactivates bacterial beta-lactamase enzymes, restoring Amoxicillin's power against resistant strains.
sideEffects: Diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, skin rash, oral thrush, or mild abdominal discomfort.
howToUse: Take 1 tablet twice daily at the start of a meal to enhance absorption and reduce gastrointestinal side effects.
working: Amoxicillin prevents bacterial cell wall synthesis while Clavulanic Acid protects Amoxicillin from degradation by bacterial beta-lactamase enzymes.
safetyAdvice: Complete the full prescribed course even if you feel better earlier. Caution in patients with liver impairment.
quickTips: Take at evenly spaced intervals, ideally at the start of meals to avoid stomach distress.
storage: Store below 25°C in a dry place. Keep out of reach of children.

name: Pantoride-DSR Capsule
description: Pantoride-DSR Capsule is a combination medicine used to treat acid reflux, heartburn, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), and indigestion when accompanied by symptoms like nausea, bloating, and upper abdominal fullness.
uses: Treatment of GERD, acid reflux, gastritis, peptic ulcers, nausea, vomiting, and feeling of fullness after eating.
benefits: Combines prokinetic action to increase gut motility with potent acid suppression for complete GERD relief.
sideEffects: Dryness in mouth, headache, dizziness, diarrhea, flatulence, or temporary stomach cramps.
howToUse: Take 1 capsule daily on an empty stomach, about 30 to 45 minutes before breakfast.
working: Domperidone increases motility in the upper digestive tract so food moves faster through the stomach; Pantoprazole inhibits proton pumps to reduce acid.
safetyAdvice: Not recommended for long-term continuous use without medical supervision. Avoid alcohol as it increases stomach acid production.
quickTips: Avoid oily, spicy, and late-night meals. Do not lie down immediately after eating.
storage: Store below 30°C in a dry place protected from direct sunlight.

name: CeraVe Hydrating Facial Cleanser
description: CeraVe Hydrating Facial Cleanser is a gentle face wash developed with dermatologists to cleanse and refresh normal to dry skin without stripping away natural moisture or disrupting the protective skin barrier.
uses: Daily facial cleansing, removing dirt, oil, and light makeup, hydrating dry or sensitive skin, and repairing damaged skin barrier.
benefits: Formulated with 3 essential ceramides and Hyaluronic acid utilizing MVE technology for 24-hour controlled hydration.
sideEffects: Extremely rare. Mild tingling in hyper-sensitive skin. Non-irritating and non-comedogenic.
howToUse: Wet face with lukewarm water. Gently massage cleanser over skin in circular motions. Rinse thoroughly and pat dry.
working: Ceramides restore natural skin lipids to lock in moisture, while Hyaluronic Acid attracts hydration to the outer skin layers.
safetyAdvice: For external use only. Avoid direct contact with eyes. If contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with water.
quickTips: Use morning and night. Follow with CeraVe Moisturizing Lotion for best results.
storage: Store at room temperature away from direct sunlight and heat.

name: OGX Biotin & Collagen Shampoo
genericName: Vitamin B7 Biotin + Hydrolyzed Collagen + Wheat Protein
description: OGX Thick & Full Biotin & Collagen Shampoo is a high-performance blend of Vitamin B7 Biotin, Collagen, and Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein that infuses nutrients into every strand to create the appearance of thicker, fuller, healthier-looking hair.
uses: Volumizing fine hair, strengthening hair strands against breakage, boosting body, and nourishing scalp.
benefits: Instantly adds volume and texture to flat hair while improving hair elasticity and shine without sulfates.
sideEffects: Eye irritation if product gets into eyes. Rinse immediately with clear water.
howToUse: Apply shampoo generously to wet hair, massage into a rich lather from scalp to ends, then rinse thoroughly.
working: Hydrolyzed collagen binds moisture to hair shafts while Biotin strengthens hair keratin structures from root to tip.
safetyAdvice: Sulfate-free formula safe for color-treated hair. For external cosmetic use only.
quickTips: Follow with OGX Biotin & Collagen Conditioner for optimal hair volume and softness.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Keep cap closed when not in use.

name: Gaviscon Double Action Liquid
genericName: Sodium Alginate + Sodium Bicarbonate + Calcium Carbonate
description: Gaviscon Double Action Liquid brings fast, long-lasting relief from heartburn and acid indigestion. It works in two ways: neutralizing excess stomach acid and forming a protective barrier raft over stomach contents to stop acid reflux.
uses: Relief from acid reflux, heartburn, indigestion, hyperacidity after meals, and indigestion during pregnancy.
benefits: Dual action formula: neutralizes acid fast and forms a physical raft barrier that lasts up to 4 hours.
sideEffects: Occasional mild constipation or diarrhea if taken in excessive amounts.
howToUse: Take 10ml to 20ml (two to four 5ml spoonfuls) after meals and at bedtime, up to 4 times a day.
working: Sodium alginate reacts with stomach acid to form a floating gel raft that physically prevents acid from surging up into the esophagus.
safetyAdvice: Contains sodium and calcium; patients on sodium-restricted diets or with kidney issues should consult a doctor.
quickTips: Shake bottle thoroughly before use. Do not freeze or refrigerate.
storage: Store below 30°C. Keep out of reach of children.

name: Disprin 300mg Soluble Tablet
description: Disprin 300mg Soluble Tablets contain Aspirin, which dissolves rapidly in water to deliver fast and effective relief from headaches, pain, inflammation, and fever.
uses: Fast relief from headache, migraine, toothache, sore throat, period pain, nerve pain, and symptoms of colds and flu.
benefits: Soluble formulation allows rapid absorption into the bloodstream for quicker onset of pain relief.
sideEffects: Stomach irritation, nausea, indigestion, or increased bleeding tendency.
howToUse: Dissolve 1 to 2 tablets in a glass of water and drink immediately after food. Repeat every 4 hours if necessary.
working: Aspirin inhibits cyclooxygenase enzymes (COX-1 & COX-2), preventing the synthesis of prostaglandins that trigger pain and fever.
safetyAdvice: Do not give to children under 16 years of age (risk of Reye's Syndrome). Do not take if you have peptic ulcers or asthma.
quickTips: Always dissolve completely in water before drinking. Take with or after food.
storage: Store in a dry place below 25°C. Keep container tightly closed.

name: Flagyl 400mg Tablet
description: Flagyl 400mg Tablet is an antiprotozoal and antibacterial medication containing Metronidazole. It is effective in eradicating anaerobic bacterial infections and intestinal parasitic infestations.
uses: Treatment of amoebiasis, giardiasis, trichomoniasis, dental infections, bacterial vaginosis, and post-surgical abdominal infections.
benefits: High bactericidal and protozoacidal activity against anaerobic pathogens throughout the body.
sideEffects: Unpleasant metallic taste in mouth, nausea, vomiting, dark-colored urine, headache, or dizziness.
howToUse: Take 1 tablet 2 to 3 times daily with meals for 5 to 10 days, strictly as prescribed by your physician.
working: Metronidazole diffuses into cell walls of microorganisms where it damages DNA structures and inhibits nucleic acid synthesis.
safetyAdvice: STRICTLY avoid alcohol during treatment and for at least 48 hours after stopping Flagyl to avoid severe vomiting and flushing reactions.
quickTips: Swallow whole with food or a large glass of water to reduce stomach discomfort.
storage: Store below 30°C protected from direct light and moisture.
